notes: 12 core phases (1-10 flow + 11 Disassembling) plus 2 auxiliary labels present in the shipped data but outside the paper's headline ontology (13 OutOfBody, 14 SevereIndex) and 1 catch-all (12 OtherIntervention); 46 steps (0='null step' through 45). Every id/name pair here is EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED against all 140 per-video label files (labels/{strasbourg,bern}/labels_by70/*.mp4.json, {phases,steps}[].{label_id,label_name}) from github.com/CAMMA-public/MultiBypass140 (cloned to inspect, 2026-09) -- zero id/name conflicts across all 140 videos. Phase id = label_id + 1; step id = label_id directly (0-based, matches Step_gt in the labels_by70_splits pickles with no offset). step_phase_consistent uses parent_phase=null for any step whose empirical (start+end)/2-time phase co-occurrence purity across all 140 videos was < 0.9 (i.e. it recurs under multiple phases) -- see the P1 handoff note for the full per-step purity table. hard_precede is the empirical first-occurrence order between every phase pair that was consistent (>=95% of videos where both phases occur) in ALL 140 videos, reduced to a minimal generating set (transitive closure fills the rest): prep before both the pouch-creation and omentum-division branches; both branches before the gastrojejunal anastomosis; that anastomosis before its test, before jejunal separation, before Petersen-space closure, before the jejunojejunal anastomosis; jejunojejunal anastomosis before its mesenteric-defect closure; every mid-procedure phase before Disassembling. Phases 5-9 (AnastomosisTest..CleaningCoagulation) interleave heavily in practice (empirical pairwise order fractions ranged 0.14-0.93, i.e. genuinely inconsistent) -> no soft_precede claimed for that cluster; OtherIntervention/OutOfBody/SevereIndex are unconstrained. IAE categories (not graph nodes): Bleeding, MechanicalInjury, ThermalInjury, IschemicInjury, InsufficientClosureOfAnastomosis, severity 0 (none) - 5.
